purpose: preserve cultural meaning without converting fiction, authored positions, derived interpretations, memes, or third-party references into historical fact

provenance_thresholds.general_cultural_pattern: documented source or explicitly labelled first-person recollection/interpretation
provenance_thresholds.named_person_or_company_claim: explicit provenance; first-person opinion must remain labelled opinion
provenance_thresholds.quotation: direct authored contribution or verifiable source required
provenance_thresholds.visual_cultural_artifact: official source metadata preferred; observed third-party bytes may be hash-described without republication when rights remain unresolved
provenance_thresholds.meme_transmission_history: provenanced third-party meme-history references may document spread and usage; creator and source-work metadata should prefer creator or official sources
